system.effect: While burning, renders the holder (and up to two touched allies) unnoticeable — even to night vision, cameras, and basilisk weapons.
system.description: A severed hand prepared as a HOG. Ignites on the command word (and can set your pocket alight); extinguished by blowing it out or repeating the word. Burning time and damage-if-used depend on class (Class 1 mouse paw 30 s, up to Class 5 30 min). Requisition DN 4:2 (Class 2–3) or 5:2 (Class 1 & 4); Certification Intro to Applied Occult Computing or Basic Stealth and Evasion.
